_doc: Hand-kept scene additions for rp_bench.py (feature_writeup/perf_rpack.md 4.2). Key = a substring of the pack's file name. blocks / entities are added to what rp_scan.py finds; entity entries are 'ns:id' or 'ns:id {nbt}' (custom NBT replaces the frozen default). noScene = why the pack gets no scene (reload is still measured).

Golden crit.noScene: crit particle texture only; shows in melee hits

Lower Shield.noScene: first-person shield model; spectator has no hand

LowOnFire.note: also lowers the burning overlay (first person, not measured)
